title: Kth Largest Element in an Array

statement.hi: Ek integer array `nums` aur integer `k` diya hai. Array ka **k-th sabse bada** element return karo — sorted order me k-th bada, k-th distinct nahi. Kya bina poora sort kiye kar sakte ho?
statement.en: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the **k-th largest** element in the array — the k-th largest in sorted order, not the k-th distinct element. Can you do it without fully sorting?

hi: Heap bada ho jaaye to smallest pop karo; aakhir me top hi answer hai.
en: Pop the smallest whenever it grows past `k`; the top at the end is the answer.

approach.hi: Size `k` ka min-heap: har number push karo, size `k` se zyada ho to top (sabse chhota) pop karo. Heap me hamesha ab tak ke `k` sabse bade bachte hain, aur top unme sabse chhota = k-th largest. O(n log k) time, O(k) space. (Quickselect average O(n) bhi deta hai.)
approach.en: Min-heap of size `k`: push every number and pop the top (smallest) whenever the size exceeds `k`. The heap always holds the `k` largest so far, and its top is the smallest of them, the k-th largest. O(n log k) time, O(k) space. (Quickselect gives O(n) on average.)
